decision_rule: ST-segment elevation in contiguous anterior leads (V1-V4) with typical anginal pain and cardiovascular risk factors is diagnostic of anterior wall STEMI requiring urgent reperfusion.

guideline_ref.name: NICE NG185
guideline_ref.key_line: Offer coronary angiography with primary PCI within 120 minutes of first medical contact for people with STEMI presenting within 12 hours of symptom onset.

misconceptions: Stable angina causes ST elevation on ECG
Pericarditis typically presents with unilateral arm pain
Aortic dissection commonly causes anterior ST elevation
Pulmonary embolism presents with ST elevation rather than right heart strain
